prompt:
Create ONE native editable static SVG sheet with TWELVE blindside future-expansion source concepts. These are visual ideas, not established content or gameplay. Exact canvas 1920x1008, viewBox 0 0 1920 1008. FOUR columns THREE rows, row-major, each cell 480x336, no gutters. Each subject in its own named top-level group with only the single specified translate, all paths LOCAL to its cell, no painted content outside groups. Keep silhouette within 12%..88% of each cell. Every concept separable, no cross-cell decoration. Cream #f3e8c8 background in each cell, forest ink #183b32, ochre #c39a52, restrained coral #bd6552. Cut-paper overlap and engraved contours, three values, quiet space, no decorative frame. Main object reads at 160x112, 80x56 and 64x45.
Cohesive engraved fantasy illustration grounded in the actual game, upper-left light, strong distinct silhouettes, broad modeled planes before sparse accents. No realistic gun designs, modern logos, glyph labels, numbers, visible text, card borders, stats or UI. No lantern, mirror or anvil; no existing runtime role is replaced. No automatic upgrades or invented rules.

Cell 1: group id="folding-fan" transform="translate(0 0)": half-open paper fan angled left, ochre guard ribs connected to one thick pivot, coral edge; broad pleats.
Cell 2: group id="ribbon-shears" transform="translate(480 0)": open steel tailor shears cutting a folded coral ribbon, clear two handles and single fitted pivot.
Cell 3: group id="abacus" transform="translate(960 0)": tilted wooden abacus with three thick rails and uneven groups of broad beads, no numbers.
Cell 4: group id="thimble" transform="translate(1440 0)": large ivory metal thimble on its open rim beside one bent needle, restrained dotted surface, no spool.
Cell 5: group id="domino-bridge" transform="translate(0 336)": three cream domino slabs leaning into a small arch on an ochre base, spare forest pips.
Cell 6: group id="tuning-fork" transform="translate(480 336)": long steel tuning fork at a diagonal with two separated thick prongs over coral felt, no sound-wave glyphs.
Cell 7: group id="bellows" transform="translate(960 336)": leather concertina bellows compressed diagonally, two wooden boards join a clear narrow nozzle.
Cell 8: group id="marionette-cross" transform="translate(1440 336)": asymmetric wooden control cross with two taut thick strings holding a single coral diamond pendant.
Cell 9: group id="matchbox" transform="translate(0 672)": part-open small ochre matchbox exposes three cream match heads, one unlit match crosses its lid.
Cell 10: group id="nesting-cups" transform="translate(480 672)": three nested copper cups, one tilted outward reveals wall thickness and dark open interior.
Cell 11: group id="corkscrew" transform="translate(960 672)": wooden T-handle corkscrew with short joined steel helix and thick cork, quiet negative space.
Cell 12: group id="pepper-mill" transform="translate(1440 672)": turned wooden pepper mill tipped slightly, brass crank at top and a few coarse dark grains beneath.
Native self-contained vector paths and simple shapes only, explicit flat paint. No raster, image, script, animation, use, external resources, gradients, filters, masks or defs. A finished coherent sibling set with useful negative space, no fine repetitive hatching. Each group extracts as an independent SVG with no lost resources.
